description: Department of Local Government Southern Province -  Notice that the Meeting for the Purpose of Electing the Vice Chairman of the Local Government in the Southern Province
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting for the purpose of electing the Vice Chairman of the Ambalangoda Urban Council, including specific details about the date, time, and location. This content falls under electoral processes for local authorities, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with election scheduling and procedures for local government positions.
